html:
Question 13
?

Given the ellipsoid (x−1)216+y24+(z+2)2=1, find the domain of z=z(x,y).

a
{(x,y):x216+y24≤1}
b
{(x,y):(x−1)216+y24<1}
c
Entire xy-plane
d
{(x,y):(x−1)216+y24≤1}
e
{(x,y):x216+y24>1}
Submit
